questions.questionText: A hyperlink is also referred to as a:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Link.

questions.questionText: A hyperlink can link to:
options: Another Web page or a section within the same page
questions.correctAnswer: Another Web page or a section within the same page
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Another Web page or a section within the same page.

questions.questionText: Which element is used to create a hyperlink?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) <a>.

questions.questionText: The A in the <a> element stands for:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Anchor.

questions.questionText: A hyperlink can be specified using:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Text or an image.

questions.questionText: When the mouse moves over a hyperlink, the cursor changes into a:
options: Hand with a pointing index finger
questions.correctAnswer: Hand with a pointing index finger
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Hand with a pointing index finger.

questions.questionText: Which attribute of <a> specifies the URL of the linked page?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) href.

questions.questionText: Which attribute was used to specify a section (anchor) of a Web page to be linked?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) name.

questions.questionText: An <a> element cannot contain:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Another <a> element.

questions.questionText: Which attribute specifies where the linked page will open?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) target.

questions.questionText: target="_self" loads the target URL:
options: In the same window as the current page
questions.correctAnswer: In the same window as the current page
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) In the same window as the current page.

questions.questionText: target="_blank" loads the target URL:
options: In a new window or tab
questions.correctAnswer: In a new window or tab
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) In a new window or tab.

questions.questionText: target="_top" loads the target URL:
options: In the complete area of the window
questions.correctAnswer: In the complete area of the window
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) In the complete area of the window.

questions.questionText: target="_parent" loads the URL in the:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Parent frame.

questions.questionText: By default (no target specified), a link opens in:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) The same window.

questions.questionText: Absolute paths are links that contain:
options: The complete address to reach a Web page
questions.correctAnswer: The complete address to reach a Web page
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) The complete address to reach a Web page.

questions.questionText: Which path type is the best way to link to another Website?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Absolute.

questions.questionText: Relative paths are used when:
options: Files are in the same folder or nearby folders on the same site
questions.correctAnswer: Files are in the same folder or nearby folders on the same site
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Files are in the same folder or nearby folders on the same site.

questions.questionText: To link to a file in a sub folder named "about-us", the href should be:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) href="about-us/file.html".

questions.questionText: To link to a file one level up in a folder, which prefix is used in a relative path?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) ../.

questions.questionText: An example of an absolute path is:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) http://www.example.com/page.html.

questions.questionText: Which keyword is used in href to link to an e-mail address?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) mailto:.

questions.questionText: Which is the correct e-mail hyperlink?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Mail.

questions.questionText: Clicking a mailto link usually:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Starts the default e-mail client.

questions.questionText: To add a subject line automatically in an e-mail link, which is used after the address?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) ?subject=.

questions.questionText: Hyperlinks can also be used to link to:
options: Zipped files, executables, documents, and PDFs
questions.correctAnswer: Zipped files, executables, documents, and PDFs
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Zipped files, executables, documents, and PDFs.

questions.questionText: Which code downloads a zipped file?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Click to download.

questions.questionText: Hyperlinks can also be used to link graphical files such as:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) .jpg and .gif.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is true about a linked image?
options: Images require JavaScript to be links
An image can serve as a hyperlink
Only text can be a link
questions.correctAnswer: An image can serve as a hyperlink
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) An image can serve as a hyperlink.

questions.questionText: A Website is a collection of:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Web pages.

questions.questionText: Navigating between pages of a Website is facilitated by:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Hyperlinks.

questions.questionText: An anchor within the same page is typically referenced using the symbol:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) #.

questions.questionText: To link to an element with id="top" in the same page, use:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) href="#top".

questions.questionText: A link to a section on a different page uses:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) page.html#section.

questions.questionText: Which is the correct syntax to provide a hyperlink?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) text.

questions.questionText: The text between and is called the:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Link text.

questions.questionText: Which attribute provides tooltip text when hovering over a link?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) title.

questions.questionText: A broken link usually results from:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) An incorrect path or URL.

questions.questionText: In a relative path, a file in the same folder is referenced by:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Only the file name.

questions.questionText: Which element should be used for a hyperlink on an image?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) .

questions.questionText: When linking an .exe file for download, the file name is placed in the:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) href attribute of <a>.

questions.questionText: A link to a PDF help file allows users to:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Download or view the document.

questions.questionText: The mailto link can also hold multiple recipients separated by:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Commas.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is NOT a valid value of the target attribute?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) _middle.

questions.questionText: Which protocol does a typical Web page link begin with?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) http://.

questions.questionText: Hyperlinks improve a Website by:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Enabling navigation between pages.

questions.questionText: An absolute link remains valid even if:
options: The linking page is moved to a different folder
questions.correctAnswer: The linking page is moved to a different folder
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) The linking page is moved to a different folder.

questions.questionText: In hyperlink terminology, "anchor text" refers to:
options: The clickable text of the link
questions.correctAnswer: The clickable text of the link
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) The clickable text of the link.

questions.questionText: Hyperlinks to e-mail addresses can be used to:
options: Create a new message with the recipient filled in
questions.correctAnswer: Create a new message with the recipient filled in
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Create a new message with the recipient filled in.
